schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Collins Lake (Region 2, Yuba Co.) for sub-catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of February-May & November-December (this entry covers the February-May window). This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant, and is separate from any private stocking by the Collins Lake concession.
